use /lib

export scope SelectionPopoverScope:
    concept: {SelectionPopoverConcept}

concept SelectionPopoverConcept:
    pitch:
        A small popover of things to do with text just selected, offered
        wherever text can be selected by dragging across it.

    shape: {SelectionPopoverShape}

shape SelectionPopoverShape:
    description:
        When a drag that selects text ends, a small popover appears just below
        and to the right of where the pointer was let go, floating above
        everything and kept within the window. It has a border, rounded corners,
        and a shadow, and holds a row of small buttons side by side, each with
        an icon and a label. Which buttons it holds, and what each does, is up
        to whatever shows it. It only appears when the drag selected some text.

    pressing:
        Pressing a button in the popover is taken by the popover alone, never
        by the text beneath, so the selection is still there when the button
        acts on it. Any of its buttons closes the popover.

    closing:
        The popover closes without doing anything when the mouse is pressed
        anywhere outside it, including to start selecting something else. Where
        it is shown can close it too, such as when what holds the text closes.
EOF
